a: Drawn effects let NaN through their clamps, where the offset effects read it as the default
bevel2 gives a non-finite `lightFrom` unstyled bands, where bevel/sheen/rivets throw a RangeError
Woodgrain's grain lines stop at a fixed -5..105 span and miss outline that warping effects push past the box
Perforations rounds its hole count up, so holes asked to sit `2 × holeRadius` apart can overlap
shadow and sunbeams draw on any variant, where every other drawn effect skips variants with no fill
b: A `bevel2` effect with a non-finite or non-numeric `lightFrom` paints every band solid black
A NaN opacity or intensity in `shadow`, `sheen`, `woodgrain` or `sunbeams` draws at full strength instead of at the default
`rivets` measures its corner entry from the farthest outline crossing behind the corner when the outline reaches past the box
The `aqua` doc says `equatorSpread` is the band's half-width, but the band below the equator is 1.6× wider
